verdict.rationale: CAM's own Legaltech & ALS page says it adopted AI/ML-based legaltech in day-to-day practice and gives a concrete use case: AI contract review with a stated 20–30% efficiency gain. That is a bit more than a bare marketing mention, but the page names no tools, publishes no AI-use policy, and describes no AI product of the firm's own. Prarambh is a general legaltech incubator, not a disclosure of how the firm uses AI with clients. missing for 10: named AI tools/vendors, published AI usage or governance policy, firm-built AI-practice products, detail on how AI is applied in client matters, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention

citations.quote: cam is the first Indian law firm to adopt Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) based Legaltech in its day-to-day practice
an average of 20% to 30% increase in efficiency
